what: Brev spend for the warm-start phase, against the $30.38 credit Brev's email reported at 22:12 UTC 2026-10-28

not_in_the_minute_ledger.note: These boxes were deleted by their finishers or are still live, so no minute line was written. Bounded from run-log first/last clip timestamps and finisher delete times; the two strong-four boxes are projected to their 2-clip runtime, not measured.

what_that_buys: $2.61 at $0.68/h is about 3.8 box-hours. A 3-clip fine-tune box measured 2.3 h end to end (bring-up, cold image build, 3 x 36 min of training, evals, pull) = ~$1.56, so ONE more small box is affordable if the -5 cm spending bar clears. It is not enough for anything in docs/TO_THE_TOP.md: the cheapest item there, the seven MP-SR near-misses, needs ~$21 of full-length training.
measured_cost_per_box: The strong-four boxes did bring-up, a cold image build, a 49 MB upload, two 50M-step fine-tunes and two evaluations in 110 minutes = $1.25/box, against the $2.25 the estimate used. So a 3-clip Tier 3 box is about $1.70, not $2.25.
what_the_last_two_boxes_bought: v2d-t3s6-a ($1.68): e06 and e12 adopted, Tier 3 v3 at 0.25197 / 51.864. v2d-t3m-a ($2.44 projected): e03 -68.84 cm, e16 -18.15, e01 -2.42, Tier 3 v4 at 0.25271 / 48.883 and the MPPE board 6th -> 5th. So ~$4.12 bought one rank point and a measured characterisation of the arm (results/t3_lockon_law.json).
an_arithmetic_correction: An earlier draft of this field said '$0.95', reached by subtracting both of the last two boxes from a $5.03 figure that already had one of them in it. The authoritative number is the computed field above: $30.38 - $27.77 = $2.61. Worth fixing rather than leaving, because a prose number that contradicts the computed one in the same file is how a later decision gets made on the wrong budget.
